semantics.serial: A single funded serial cycle is established for the swaps observed.
semantics.batch: Several paths or closed subgroups coexist, or the receipt and trace prove multi-asset borrowing and repayment around the swaps.
semantics.mixed: One or more closes coexist with a cashout or an unresolved remainder.
semantics.unresolved: Landed/indexed logs exist, but organization remains unclear.
semantics.control: A landed comparison, LP operation, or otherwise established nonclosure.
semantics.swaps: Count from the strongest available source. It may be only shapes. See swap_observations and evidence_level.
semantics.max_proven_funded_pool_swaps: Largest evidenced linked path in this record. A cashout can extend this beyond a closed cycle. Zero and absence have different meanings.
semantics.costs: Amounts are raw decimal integers keyed by asset or BNB wei. A scoped visible zero does not establish owner PnL. Receipt gas is actual inclusive charged gas only where recorded.
semantics.denominators: Cohorts overlap and apply different filters. They cannot be added. Absence from the individually listed samples conveys no assessment.
semantics.rebuild: python docs/verification/fixtures/build_bsc_multihop_inventory_20261127.py from a checkout with the listed retained evidence.
